{{Money|30}} on death (Hard) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Fanatic''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had a low amount of health and fast speed. ==Logbook Description== "''A Fanatic is someone obsessed with the arts and theater. They have taken to Narrator's control more intensely than others and rush to serve at a moment's notice. Fanatics are known to run indefinitely, causing the one being controlled to be in a constant state of exhaustion until their final breath.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fanatic''' is a dark creature which wears a purple shirt, blue vest and a yellow tie. On its head, it wears a white mask. It has two walking animations it can use. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *The '''Fanatic''' is quite weak, meaning most early-game towers can handle it. **Early-game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are pretty useful here. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to kill multiple at once. *Later on, the '''Fanatic''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FanaticRun1.gif|Walking animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) FanaticRun2.gif|Walking animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) FanaticStun.gif|Walking animation, third variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFanatic1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) CorpseFanatic2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} "The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fanatic''' in [[The Narratorium]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FanaticIconIG.png|'''Fanatic''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Fanatic''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Fanatic''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Fanatic''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Attendee]]|Wave 1|Fanatic|Wave 2|[[Sack Noob]] & [[Extra A]]|Wave 4}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
